title: Token Breadcrumbs: Compact cost journey & export UX for Console
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design a compact, role-aware 'breadcrumb' view that surfaces token-level cost journey for an invocation/session. Focus on skimmable cost breakdowns, attribution toggles, and CSV/ledger export options tailored to engineering and finance personas. The component should fit into per-route dashboards and rollouts. Prototype deliverables: Figma flows, HTML prototype (react sandbox), and export CSV schema.
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumb shows top-level cost, latency, and token count in a single-line compact row with micro-sparkline for cost over time
Users can expand the breadcrumb to view attribution tiers (model, tokens, caching, batch) with percent and absolute cost
Role filter toggles change export columns (engineer view includes prompt+latency; finance view includes chargeback tags and SKU)
Export button offers CSV and 'Ledger JSON' (schema v1) and respects time-range and role filters
Component passes contrast and keyboard-accessibility checks and has aria-labels for interactive elements
tasks: Finalize visual tokens (typography, micro-spacing, chip styles) with design system
Prototype expansion animation and micro-sparkline in Figma
Document CSV/Ledger export schema and example rows in Confluence
Sync with runtime team to validate cost attribution keys and availability
Run 3 usability sessions (engineering, finance, support) and iterate
comments: 2026-02-16 Avery Chen: Initial sketch complete — single-line breadcrumb plus affordance to expand. Raised question about whether to include model hash in compact view.
2026-02-20 Jordan Martinez (PM): Prefer model hash in expanded view only; finance asked for SKU-level tag in default export.
2026-02-24 Priya Rao (Eng): Runtime can provide attribution keys per-request but needs a bounded schema; listed required fields for CSV.
2026-02-26 Riley Patel: Mid-fidelity prototype uploaded to Figma, added micro-sparkline and role toggle. Requesting accessibility review.
2026-03-01 Design Review: Approve visuals; ask to reduce chip count in compact state and add 'sampled' badge for sampled attributions
decisions: Keep compact state to max 3 chips (cost, tokens, latency) — additional metrics live in expanded panel
Export schema will include a 'chargeback_tags' column and a 'sampled' boolean
Sparklines are sampled at 1-minute granularity to balance performance with signal
next_steps: Address accessibility notes and annotate Figma with aria attributes
Implement React prototype in console sandbox and link to QA story
Coordinate with runtime to stage ledger export endpoint (v1) behind a feature flag
Schedule usability sessions and collect recording/transcripts
accessibility_considerations: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for small text on chips and sparklines tooltip
Keyboard focus order: expandable row -> role toggle -> export menu
Provide descriptive aria-labels for 'sampled' badge and export options
